create_LLMClient: create an LLMClient instance to interface with VLLM or OpenAI-compatible LLM servers
generate_completion: generate a chat completion response from an LLM using the LLMClient generate method
strip_think_tokens: strip thinking tokens from LLM response text using the strip_think_tokens function
get_model_client: get an OpenAI or AzureOpenAI client for a given model URL and API key
flush_logs: flush LLMClient metrics logs to a JSON file using the flush_logs method
